**Finding: Compliant (at fallback)** — no redline proposed.

The agreement does contain a minimum commitment (Section 5a: monthly minimums for Hosting and Support Services), so it is not at our preferred usage-only position. But it clears the fallback comfortably:

- **Term-limited:** Section 13 sets a one-year term with annual auto-renewal and a 30-day non-renewal notice right, so the commitment never extends beyond the current 12-month term.
- **Exit right:** Section 14 lets Client terminate at any time, with services and fees ending the last day of the month following the notice month — effectively a 30–60 day walk-out.
- **No penalty mechanic:** there is no shortfall charge, liquidated damages, or acceleration of remaining minimums, and no volume cap on Client's usage.

Two drafting points flagged in the rationale rather than as deviations: the minimum dollar figures are still blank and should be filled in or struck at signature; and Section 6's carve-out preventing Client from contesting or receiving backup for the "minimum monthly fees listed in Section 4" mis-cites the section (the minimums live in Section 5) — worth fixing for clarity.
